name: A 579-Concept Endpoint Failure under Reduction
definition: From the certified $289$-concept rooted factor $(B,29)$ and its support-four repair $M=B\cup\{157\}$, form $Y=(M\times\{0\})\cup(B\times\{1\})$ and mark $r=(29,0)$.
parameters: $|Y|=579$, isometric dimension $13$, and VC dimension $4$; the reduction in the fresh direction is $B$.
properties: $Y$ peels to $r$ although $B$ cannot peel to $29$. Its only corners are $(157,0)$ and $(29,1)$, and every root-ending peeling deletes $(29,1)$ first. The full fibre through the root survives, so the failure is specifically prescribed-endpoint transport rather than emptiness of the reduced root fibre.
